review:
Eastern Fury is a Pragmatic Play slot set among rival gangs on a 5x5 grid, where three or more matching symbols from left to right pay instantly. The feature is the expanding wild on reel five: it covers the whole reel and takes one of two competing multiplier values from 2x to 100x. If no win follows in the base game, the wild and its multiplier stay put, a respin is awarded and another expanding wild lands on the next reel, continuing right to left until a win hits with all the multipliers added together.

Three to five scatters trigger 10 to 20 free spins, where expanded wilds are sticky and land in order from right to left. A super scatter in the trigger awards Super Free Spins with a minimum multiplier of 10x. Try the free demo to see the respin chain in action; it's a high-tension slot for players who like watching multipliers stack across the reels.
